dog.description_text:
Hi! I just arrived! I’m Mags or Honeybun as I’m known at my foster home! I am a sweet goofy love bug who loves playing and lots of cuddles!
Honeybun Mags gets on well with her sister who is currently being fostered in the same home - they love playing tug of war and chase before cuddling up for nap time! Mags is still a puppy but has very quickly learned how to use wee-wee pads, and i think will pick up outside potty training very quickly once she allowed outside.
Honeybun Mags is a sweet curious puppy who is making great progress on potty training and puppy manners. She is generally a quiet puppy but can be a bit noisy during play when excited. She is an adorable pup who follows me everywhere and loves cuddles & snuggling on the sofa - as soon as you sit she is straight in for a snuggly cuddle!
ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
